source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: אחרי העבודה אני הולך לחנות גדולה.
sentences.en: After work I go to a big shop.
I take a trolley and start shopping.

sentences.ar: אני קונה חלב, לחם, ביצים וגבינה.
sentences.en: I buy milk, bread, eggs and cheese.
At the checkout there's a long queue.
I wait and look at the people.

sentences.ar: אחר כך אני משלם והולך הביתה.
sentences.en: Afterwards I pay and go home.
